SPY.title: Mohamed El-Erian Slams 'Backward-Looking' Powell, Question's Fed's 2% Inflation Target—'Being Too Late'
SPY.description: Economist Mohamed El-Erian criticized Federal Reserve Chair Jerome Powell for being 'backward-looking' and potentially making policy mistakes regarding inflation, suggesting the Fed should consider cutting rates and potentially revising its 2% inflation target.
SPY.author: Namrata Sen

SPY.title: Homebuilder Stocks Are Rallying: Is the Optimism Premature?
SPY.description: Homebuilder stocks are experiencing a rally despite ongoing challenges in the housing market, including high mortgage rates and reduced construction permits. The SPDR S&P Homebuilders ETF is trading near its highest level since December, but uncertainties remain about future housing market conditions.
SPY.author: James Picerno
